import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Species Classification Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for species
palette = {'setosa': '#2ecc71', 'versicolor': '#3498db', 'virginica': '#e74c3c'}

# 1. Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width (best separating features)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='petal_length', y='petal_width', hue='species', 
                palette=palette, s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', loc='upper left')

# 2. Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', hue='species', 
                palette=palette, s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', loc='upper right')

# 3. Box plot: Distribution of all measurements by species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars=['species'], 
                     value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                     var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
sns.boxplot(data=df_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', 
            palette=palette, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'])
ax3.legend(title='Species', loc='upper right')

# 4. Violin plot: Petal length distribution (most discriminative feature)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', palette=palette, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add sample counts as text annotations
for i, species in enumerate(df['species'].unique()):
    count = len(df[df['species'] == species])
    ax4.text(i, df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].max() + 0.3, 
             f'n={count}', ha='center', fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
